facts.text: The hotel faces Lake Geneva, minutes from the parks and boutiques of rue du Rhone.
facts.excerpt: Facing Lake Geneva and minutes from the parks and boutiques of rue du Rhône

facts.text: The hotel has a prime lakefront location within walking distance of the city center, in a very peaceful area.
facts.excerpt: At once at a walking distance to the city center and at the same time on a very peaceful area, Hotel President Wilson, A Luxury Collection Hotel, Geneva, benefits from a prime lakefront location.

facts.text: The hotel is close to international organizations including the UN, as well as diplomatic missions and consulates.
facts.excerpt: Conveniently located close to the most recognized Swiss factories, international organizations including the UN, OMS, OMC, OMPI, diplomatic missions and consulates

facts.text: Across the Mont-Blanc Bridge on the left bank are the Jardin Anglais (English Garden) and the Flower Clock.
facts.excerpt: Crossing the Mont-Blanc Bridge towards the left bank, the Jardin Anglais (English Garden) awaits, as well as the famous Flower Clock

facts.text: The hotel was designed by architect and hotelier Marcel Jacquignon and first opened in 1962.
facts.excerpt: Designed by architect and hotelier Marcel Jacquignon, Hotel President opened its doors for the first time on May 18, 1962.

facts.text: It reopened in 1996 as Hotel President Wilson, named in honor of Woodrow Wilson, the 28th President of the United States.
facts.excerpt: The hotel reopened in 1996 as the new Hotel President Wilson, in honor of the 28th President of the United States of America, Woodrow Wilson

facts.text: Public areas are characterized by three themes conceived by South Korean artist Jae-Hyo Lee: water, surrounding landscape and light.
facts.excerpt: characterized by three main themes conceptualized by South-Korean artist Jae-Hyo Lee: water, surrounding landscape and light.

facts.text: The Royal Penthouse Floor stretches across the entire 8th floor.
facts.excerpt: Succumb to the ultimate luxury of our Royal Penthouse Floor, stretching on the entire 8th floor, namely 1,680 sqm.

facts.text: Suites have floor-to-ceiling windows with views of the lake, pool and city.
facts.excerpt: Luxury suites in Geneva feature floor-to-ceiling windows with views of the lake, pool, and city.

facts.text: Bathrooms are marble, with Byredo bath amenities.
facts.excerpt: marble bathrooms feature ByRedo bath amenities

facts.text: Rooms have twice-daily housekeeping.
facts.excerpt: our twice-daily housekeeping service ensures guests are always in impeccably tidy surroundings

facts.text: The hotel has the first spa in Switzerland to feature La Mer skincare products and Signature treatments.
facts.excerpt: The Hotel President Wilson boasts the first Spa in Switzerland to feature the prestigious and sought-after La Mer skincare products and Signature treatments.

facts.text: A private Spa Suite with steam room, sauna and relaxing area is available exclusively with spa packages.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy the ultimate privilege of our Spa Suite including, steam room, sauna and relaxing area, available exclusively with our Spa packages.

facts.text: Body treatments include scrubs, massages, foot reflexology, lymphatic drainage and a hammam ritual.
facts.excerpt: The spa offers a wide range of body treatments including scrubs, massages, foot reflexology, lymphatic drainage and hammam ritual.

facts.text: The heated outdoor pool is on the first-floor terrace and overlooks Lake Geneva, the Alps and the Mont Blanc range.
facts.excerpt: Located on the first-floor terrace, our soothing swimming pool overlooks Lake Geneva and the panoramic Alps and Mont Blanc range across the distance.

facts.text: The Rive Droite terrace has a beach club ambiance with a heated pool, a lounge bar and a restaurant.
facts.excerpt: Nestled on the first floor terrace of Hotel President Wilson, the Rive Droite welcomes you in a beach club ambiance with a heated swimming pool, a lounge bar and a restaurant.

facts.text: The swimming pool is open only during summertime.
facts.excerpt: The swimming pool is only open during summertime

facts.text: Bayview offers a seasonal menu of locally sourced products with views of Lake Geneva and the Alps.
facts.excerpt: The Chef presents a seasonal menu crafted from locally sourced products, offering an authentic gastronomic experience paired with stunning views of Lake Geneva and the Alps.

facts.text: Bayview holds one Michelin star.
facts.excerpt: have been awarded one Michelin star and 18/20 in the Gault&Millau guide

facts.text: Arabesque serves traditional Lebanese cuisine in an oriental setting.
facts.excerpt: The famous Lebanese Arabesque restaurant invites you for a culinary journey in an oriental setting.

facts.text: A Tom Ford beauty boutique is located at the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Tom Ford beauty welcomes you every day in its Geneva boutique, located at Hotel President Wilson.

facts.text: The concierge desk offers three Lake Geneva running routes, from short to long.
facts.excerpt: Discover our three routes from short to long available at our concierge desk

facts.text: The fitness room has Technogym equipment including treadmills, elliptical cross trainers and a Kinesis wall.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy Technogym facilities including treadmills, elliptical cross trainers, Kinesis® wall.

facts.text: The hotel welcomes trained pets.
facts.excerpt: we also welcome trained pets

facts.text: The hotel calls itself one of the city's most contemporary addresses.
facts.excerpt: is one of the city's most contemporary addresses, framed by Mont Blanc
